text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Takarazuka Kinen drawing 
near, I spotted Bamboo Memory giving it 
her all in training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki chided her for being 
reckless, but Bamboo Memory insisted it 
was better to give it everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Bamboo Memory muttered to herself, 
feeling that Yaeno Muteki hadn't been able 
to give it her all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen had arrived. Even 
Inari One gave Yaeno Muteki an earful, 
asking what the point was in holding back 
her strength now.
